subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw surface the existing admin-scoped `configPath` in the Overview snapshot card, move it to Settings/Config, or keep config-path discovery in CLI/troubleshooting surfaces?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the linked request leaves the UI location open and prominently rendering an absolute local path is a product and sensitivity choice.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this display-only approach after redacted running-Control-UI proof shows the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings
options.body: Ask for the same existing field to be displayed in a less prominent Settings or Config information area instead of Overview.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline UI exposure and rely on existing config-path command and troubleshooting surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this display-only approach after redacted running-Control-UI proof shows the existing admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview presentation surface that would receive the visible row.
